jobs.title: Senior Partner, Germany
jobs.description: About the Role A legal technology company is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled law practice in Germany. You will bring an established client practice, continue advising clients, and help move recurring legal work onto AI-powered workflows. What You'll Do Help shape the firm's growth and contribute to its path toward Series A. Transition your portable client practice to the firm's platform while continuing to serve those clients. Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network. Identify cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services across your client base. Work with the founding team to automate recurring legal matters using AI agents. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level. German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base that follows you independently of a large-firm brand. Strong relationships with private equity or venture capital firms and their portfolio companies, or a comparable mid-market client network. Experience with recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory matters. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI products, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows to automation. A feasible client transition plan, including a notice period and no restrictions that prevent moving your practice. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. Meaningful equity is offered. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Berlin, Germany. The role may be based in person or remote within Germany; Berlin in-person work is preferred. jobs.title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
jobs.description: Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage? Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up. And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities. The job You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets. Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap. Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched. Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early. Take products to new countries: localise what already works, with country leads and local counsel. Build the playbooks: templates that let Legal scale without adding friction. Why you'll want it Spend your time on the hard questions. You're asked to shape our roadmap and launches, and understand how to fit them to the relevant regimes Be a peer, with room to run. Legal in the room from day one is how products here ship sooner. That's the whole point of your seat. Make sending money home cheaper. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia.
